afterImage.description: Exus Renewables North America is a U.S.-based independent power producer, developer and operator that acquires, develops, repowers, builds, owns and manages utility-scale wind, solar and battery-storage assets. Headquartered in Pittsburgh, the platform also maintains U.S. offices in New York, Albuquerque and Connecticut and reports more than 6 GW of total capacity, including more than 700 MW operating or under construction. Partners Group invested on October 3, 2023 through Exus US Holdings, LP alongside retained founders and management, committing growth capital to build a standalone North American platform. The global Exus brand, investment holdcos, individual projects, bolt-ons and third-party mandates are not separate PortCos. No later platform sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.
